profile.headline: Software Engineer at KAYAK
profile.summary:
I recently graduated from Bentley University, where I obtained a bachelor's degree in Computer Information Systems (with a minor in Finance). My biggest strengths are critical thinking and problem solving; these traits have helped me take ideas and turn them into prototype IT solutions for multiple Top 500 Revenue firms. 

During my Junior and Senior years at Walpole High School, I worked for Fidelity Investments as a Technical Intern. While I was there, I created two dynamically updating websites using front and back-end web technologies such as HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript, MySQL, and PHP. 

At Bentley, I familiarized myself with other popular technologies like Python, Docker, and Java. I finished my college career by leading a group of 4 other consultants on a collaborative project between Bentley and Analog Devices. In one semester, we were able to construct the foundational components of a SharePoint-based full-stack web app for the firm and hand it off to Analog's engineering team. 

I will be using the valuable experiences I've gained up to this point to help KAYAK's mWeb UI team transition the architecture of the site between JS frameworks (from Angular to React).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helping the mWeb UI team transition the architecture of the site between JS frameworks (from Angular and AngularJS to React).

On our mobile website, currently making contributions to the Flights, Stays, Cars, and Booking product areas by maintaining existing code and building new features for our users with Angular, AngularJS, and React.

positions.title: Meat Clerk
positions.description: Responsible for stocking meat department with fresh food daily and rotating older product forward to mitigate perished inventory. Additional weekly tasks included grinding beef, making burger patties, and wrapping and pricing product. Provided excellent service for customers at the meat counter.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
On Chris Wojtowicz’s agile Core Software Engineering team, I collaborated with another intern on the Benefits Registry Administration UI, which required front and back-end web development skills. I built the front-end of the app (using tools such as Handlebars.js, HTML5, and CSS3) and linked it to the backend. Its features (including searching and filtering) have enabled Fidelity WPS representatives to quickly access and make changes to client accounts, resulting in shorter call durations. 

Gained exposure to Java coding through other small assignments from coworkers over the summer.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
Contributed to Rahil Nizamuddin’s team, which developed financial services products like Fidelity’s Automated Managed Platform. 

I was tasked with reducing the size of a weekly list of status reports which used InfoPath, Excel, and PowerPoint. Instead, I opted to transfer the data from Excel tables to a MySQL database, which allowed the data to be accessed and manipulated by any project managers via a PHP-based web application. Using this application, project managers could easily input their projects’ statuses; then, these items were automatically compiled into a comprehensive report, which depicted the health of all Fidelity AMP projects. The AMP program manager, who would normally spend hours creating PowerPoint reports for higher level executives and lower level project managers, was able to utilize this application to serve both audiences at the same time, saving a lot of time.

projects.title: Analog Devices Collaborative Project
projects.description:
• Led a group of 5 consulting students in creating a prototype IT solution to address a problem specified by our client firm.
• Gained exposure to agile software development: iterated on website using weekly feedback from client and team-members as a guide.
• Created a home-lab development environment for Microsoft SharePoint using VMware vSphere.
• Developed a responsive and dynamic intranet site for the client using technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, jQuery, and SharePoint Designer. Enabled users to submit access requests via a SharePoint custom list form. Responsive design was achieved using CSS Flexbox, allowing users to use the site on desktops, laptops, or smartphones. Data displayed on pages were sourced from backend SharePoint custom lists, allowing the web application to be scaled to accommodate more services in the future.

projects.title: First Data-Driven Python Web Application
projects.description:
This data science project was the final project for my CS230 (Intro to Python) course at Bentley. Please use the link above to view the finished web app!

This program contains 2 different applications (i.e. queries).

1. Allows the user to filter data using Streamlit UI controls and Pandas dataframes.

In this case the user may be a customer looking to purchase a used car based on some preferences. This page contains two different visualizations: (1) a Streamlit UI table, and (2) a Catalog section that makes use of custom HTML and CSS snippets.


2. Allows the user to filter data by US State.

This page contains two different visualizations: (1) a matplotlib bar graph that displays the most popular regions in a given state (using a dataframe that groups by region and counts the number of listings in each region), and (2) a PyDeck scatterplot map that plots all of the listings in the chosen state. The points' radii are chosen based on the price of the car, and the color is chosen based on the region it was posted in. They also have tooltips, which show more useful information about each listing as the user hovers over each point.
